paragraphs.text: Our Services
01 / Book Launches
paragraphs.cls: mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white/45

paragraphs.text: A synchronised launch built on pre-order momentum, launch-week creator waves, and post-release discovery that keeps the book moving long after the week is over.
“The detective was never investigating a stranger.”
Your older books still have readers waiting. We reposition published titles around current reader tropes and rebuild discovery around them.
Become an author readers follow, not just a book they bought. A monthly content engine built around your voice, with about an hour of filming a week.
